dnsbl_version.description: Version identifier embedded in the DNS response (e.g., for daemon identification). Leave blank to omit.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout (useful with systemd).

pid_file.description: Path where the daemon writes its PID file.

service_user.description: Unix username under which the daemon will run (for security).

service_group.description: Unix group name for the daemon (optional; pairs with `service_user`).

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the DNS server to. Use '127.0.0.1' for loopback-only, or '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

items.description: A valid IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind to.

listen_port.description: DNS port used for all listen addresses unless overridden per-address in `listen_addresses`.

zones.description: List of DNSBL zones to serve. Each entry defines a zone and its SOA/RR behavior.

name.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the zone (e.g., 'bl.example.com').

type.description: How the zone data is provided: 'simple' (auto-generated minimal zone), 'file' (read from zone file), or 'data' (explicit data format file).

file.description: Path to zone file (used only when `type` = 'file').

data_file.description: Path to the data file (used only when `type` = 'data').

data_format.description: Format of the data file: 'ip' (one IP per line), 'cidr' (CIDR blocks), or 'list' (key=value pairs).

rrttl.description: TTL for all resource records in this zone (seconds).

default_ttl.description: Default TTL used when records lack an explicit TTL.

max_ttl.description: Upper bound on record TTLs in this zone.

min_ttl.description: Lower bound on record TTLs in this zone.

soa_serial.description: Serial number for the zone (used by DNS for zone updates).

soa_minimum.description: SOA minimum TTL (used for negative caching).

soa_primary.description: Primary name server for this zone.

soa_responsible.description: Email of the zone administrator (use '.' instead of '@').

extra_zones.description: Additional zones not using the standard `zones` block — often for legacy or advanced setups.

source_file.description: Path to external zone file (required if no inline data).
